model_output.verdict: A senior payments engineer whose resume connects technical work to operational results.
write_up: This is a strong payments resume! At Tidewater Commerce, you show both the engineering work and what it changed, from fewer reconciliation breaks to fewer integration incidents. Your earlier billing work reinforces the same backend story.
The ledger line is a great model: it names what you built and puts the change in reconciliation breaks right beside it. Your senior headline fits the work, and your experience leads before education.

I'd make one small addition to the Northwind observability line, then keep the rest intact. Your resume isn't likely to be the thing holding you back; the competitiveness of the roles you choose will matter too.

fit.note: Your experience points toward senior backend work in payments and billing. The migration, ledger, audit and mentoring work show both technical ownership and team leadership.
